digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/DC adapter – user identity resolution
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, and this difference must be encapsulated in a stable UserIdentityModel contract to prevent assignee-diff churn.

PR #120's getattr-based _assignee_resolver was never set on Data Center, making the authoritative branch unreachable and causing permanent non-authoritative assignee resolution that re-emits unconverged changes.

NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and enable diff convergence, in contrast to PR #120's behavior of always returning authoritative=False.
The UserIdentityModel protocol must define resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload(value) returning the deployment's assignee field shape.

A shared parameterized contract test must verify both implementations handle empty values, converged values, and divergent values identically, with an anti-churn oracle asserting DC returns authoritative=True for resolvable assignees.
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for both models rather than silently returning non-authoritative values.
